summary: Tested backend (POST /api/games, GET /api/games/recent, GET /api/games/summary) and frontend Coven of Witches game flow: setup screen with player-count switching (3/4/5/6), rules/stats dialogs, sound toggle, pass-and-play privacy gates, card passing phase (3 cards for 3-player game), trick play (arm+cast two-tap), lead-suit indicator, and trick resolution/winner banner. All flows work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — should migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
GameResult.created_at is stored as ISO string; sorting by created_at works because ISO-8601 is lexicographically sortable, but a native datetime + BSON date would be more robust.
App.js has duplicated icon-button toolbar rendered twice (once in header, once in setup) — could be extracted into a shared component.

Round scoring / game-over flow (70-point threshold) was not fully played through end-to-end (would require ~20 tricks per round); reducer logic reviewed and appears sound but not exercised at runtime.
seed_data_creation: 3 game results inserted with TEST_-prefixed player names via backend tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_games.py (5 tests, all passing). Frontend Playwright flow verified: 3-player setup with names Alice/Bob/Cara → pass gate → pass 3 cards (x3 players) → play gate → arm+cast one legal card (x3 players) → trick-winner-banner + lead-suit indicator + continue-trick all work. To play a full round to reach roundScores/gameOver would require ~20 tricks; not run in this iteration but reducer/engine code appears correct.
